waivers.reason: crypto-bigint 0.5.5 comes only through webrtc 0.14 -> dtls -> p256/p384 0.13 -> elliptic-curve, with no compatible fix (dtls 0.17.2 still needs p256 ^0.13). The fixed constant-time paths are absent from 0.5.5 or not called by that chain; DTLS signatures use ring and p256/p384 only compute single-use ECDHE keys. Accepted for local-network trials only until the webrtc 0.21 migration. Owner-approved <date>; see SECURITY.md, Dependency advisories.
